hints.tr: `while heap:` içinde `cost, r, c = heapq.heappop(heap)`; `cost > best[(r, c)]` ise eski kayıt, atla.
hints.en: Inside `while heap:`, `cost, r, c = heapq.heappop(heap)`; if `cost > best[(r, c)]` it is an old record, skip.

hints.tr: Dört komşu: `new = cost + grid[nr][nc]`; daha ucuzsa `best`'e yaz ve heap'e ekle.
hints.en: Four neighbours: `new = cost + grid[nr][nc]`; if cheaper, write it to `best` and push it.
